The caller specifies the trustee name. The function sets other members of the structure to default values. ## -parameters ### -param pTrustee [in, out] A pointer to a TRUSTEE structure to initialize. The BuildTrusteeWithName function does not allocate any memory. If this parameter is NULL or a pointer that is not valid, the results are undefined. ### -param pName [in, optional] A pointer to a null-terminated string that contains the name of the trustee for the ptstrName member of the TRUSTEE structure. The BuildTrusteeWithName function sets the other members of the TRUSTEE structure as follows.
